admission.justification: Realized across five public documentation files (docs/reference/knowledge-system.md, docs/features.md, docs/reference/settings-json.md, docs/architecture.md, and docs/reference/runtime-layout.md) that jointly specify AR's multi-language anchoring, cache, and configuration contract.

applicability: Public documentation pages docs/reference/knowledge-system.md, docs/features.md, docs/reference/settings-json.md, docs/architecture.md, and docs/reference/runtime-layout.md.
conditions: docs/reference/knowledge-system.md and docs/features.md describe the 75-tree-sitter plus built-in Lean catalog, lazy AR_LANGUAGE_CACHE verification, qualifier policies, guaranteeTier, ambiguous suffix defaults, languages scan/warm CLI, and the JS/TS-only test-case modifier boundary (.each/.for line-range vs .skip/.todo/.skipIf/.runIf/.fails refusal).

docs/reference/settings-json.md documents user and repo languages.json keys (matching language_config._ALLOWED_CUSTOM_KEYS), Bend2 local custom example, local-only security boundary, and .lean reservation.

docs/architecture.md records lazy AR_LANGUAGE_CACHE grammar unpacking as a read-side persistent write boundary, and docs/reference/runtime-layout.md lists ~/.local/state/agents-remember/grammars among external files.
exclusions: Pre-existing out-of-scope doc deferrals on docs/features.md (4,000 vs 5,000 token ceiling) and docs/reference/knowledge-system.md (clause_title fallback and memory-briefs CLI) remain tracked on DPD-EG5TYT and DPD-TXRND9.
